name: A Western woman seated by a mirror
summary: A drawing of a Western woman, in a low-cut dress with shoulder ruffles, who adjusts a floral bouquet on her bodice; she is seated by a framed mirror which is held by a second Western woman. On the back are pencil sketches of Chinese porters and a dog.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
